function.name: token_risk
function.description: Pre-trade safety score for any Base token — Pass a token contract address and get a risk score + flags (ERC-20 conformance, ownership renounce, upgradeable proxy) computed live from Base. Built for trading bots and agents that vet tokens before buying. Required input: address. Priced $0.03 per call over x402 on Base; send a prepaid x-credit-token header for unlimited calls, or get 1 free call/day per tool. No wallet or API key required.

function.name: gas_oracle
function.description: Live Base gas estimates — slow / normal / fast — Returns current Base gas fees (baseFee, maxPriorityFee) and three tiered suggestions (slow, normal, fast) in Gwei, derived live from the Base RPC. Built for agents that time or cost-estimate transactions. Priced $0.01 per call over x402 on Base; send a prepaid x-credit-token header for unlimited calls, or get 1 free call/day per tool. No wallet or API key required.

function.name: ai_translate
function.description: Translate up to 6K chars to any language — LLM-quality translation as a pay-per-call primitive: send text= (up to 6K characters) and to= any language, get only the translation back — no notes, no wrapper prose, safe to pipe straight into the next step. Priced by length: $0.03 to 2,000 characters, $0.08 above — the 402 challenge quotes the price for the text you sent. No API key or subscription. Built for agents localizing content, parsing foreign-language sources, or serving multilingual users. Required input: text. Priced $0.03 per call over x402 on Base; send a prepaid x-credit-token header for unlimited calls, or get 1 free call/day per tool. No wallet or API key required.
